activity_summary: At home you said Gaunt was done and the three leaves had stayed under the book. You did not play them. The boy was not in the room. Tomorrow the three nights are named, and you are still promising no surprise.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the leaves had stayed under the book.

facets.activity: Came home with the leaves still under the book

quotes.text: The three leaves stayed under the book. I did not play them.
